commits.message:
Fix integration tests and update README for Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.3.6

- Replace flapdoodle embedded MongoDB (blocked by proxy) with mongo-java-server
  (pure Java in-memory MongoDB, no binary download required)
- Add MongoTestConfig @TestConfiguration for integration tests
- Fix Logback config: replace removed SizeAndTimeBasedFNATP with
  SizeAndTimeBasedRollingPolicy (Logback 1.3+ compatible)
- Remove ambiguous @ExceptionHandler for MaxUploadSizeExceededException
  (now handled by ResponseEntityExceptionHandler in Spring Framework 6)
- Fix PaymentControllerV2/V3: replace EntityModel<String> (can't @JsonUnwrapped)
  with PaymentResource to fix HTTP 500 on POST /payments
- Fix REST Docs field documentation: add nested fields for store, products,
  errors arrays, and _links; use ignored() for null id field
- Update README: reflect Java 21, Spring Boot 3.3.6, updated dependencies,
  replace outdated port/embedmongo-spring references

commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
Modernize project to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.3.6

- Upgrade Spring Boot 1.3.5 → 3.3.6 (removes all known CVEs)
- Upgrade Java 1.8 → 21 (LTS)
- Upgrade Maven wrapper 3.3.3 → 3.9.9
- Migrate javax.* → jakarta.* across all source files
- Update Spring HATEOAS 0.x API → 2.x:
  ResourceSupport → RepresentationModel
  Resource<T> → EntityModel<T>
  PagedResources<T> → PagedModel<T>
  ResourceAssemblerSupport → RepresentationModelAssemblerSupport
  ControllerLinkBuilder → WebMvcLinkBuilder
  toResource() → toModel(), createResourceWithId() → createModelWithId()
  CurieProvider moved to org.springframework.hateoas.mediatype.hal
  RelProvider → LinkRelationProvider
  EntityLinks.linkToSingleResource() → linkToItemResource()
- Replace cz.jirutka embedmongo-spring and pjl-comp-filter with
  de.flapdoodle.embed.mongo.spring31x 4.11.0 (Spring Boot 3.1+ integration)
- Fix PaymentServiceImpl: findOne() → findById().orElse(null)
- Remove @EnableWebMvc and @EnableEntityLinks from Config (auto-configured)
- Migrate tests: JUnit 4 → JUnit 5 (ExtendWith, BeforeEach, Assertions)
- Replace @Rule RestDocumentation with RestDocumentationExtension
- Update application.properties: remove deprecated Spring Boot 1.x properties
- Replace explicit JUnit 4 dependency with junit-platform-suite
